d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.zh: 歐盟今年7月共計13國報告118例確定病例,以保加利亞(61 例)、義大利(29例)、西班牙(7例)、波蘭(7例)及比利時(4例)為多。近12個月(2025/8/1-2026/7/31)共計30國報告2,339例病例,其中2,012例(86.0%)經實驗室確診。個案集中於15歲(含)以上(51.2%)。ECDC評估疫情主因為部分國家疫苗覆蓋率不足、境外移入等因素,並呼籲各國提升疫苗覆蓋率至95%以上。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至9/5(第35週),計17個國家/地區累計報告52,676例確定病例及61例死亡(CFR:0.12%),較去年同期病例數增加約3.8倍。有99.5%的病例集中於瓜地馬拉(33,334 例)、墨西哥(12,848例)、美國(3,134例)、秘魯(1,997例)及加拿大(1,119例);泛美衛生組織(PAHO)預計今年11月進行評估墨西哥消除麻疹認證。
d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.en: In July this year, 13 EU countries reported a total of 118 confirmed cases, mainly Bulgaria (61), Italy (29), Spain (7), Poland (7) and Belgium (4). Over the past 12 months (1 August 2025–31 July 2026), 30 countries reported 2,339 cases, of which 2,012 (86.0%) were laboratory-confirmed. Cases are concentrated among people aged 15 and over (51.2%). The ECDC attributes the outbreaks mainly to insufficient vaccination coverage in some countries and imported cases, and calls on countries to raise vaccination coverage to above 95%. In the Americas, as of 5 September this year (week 35), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 52,676 confirmed cases and 61 deaths (CFR 0.12%), about 3.8 times the number in the same period last year. Some 99.5% of cases were concentrated in Guatemala (33,334), Mexico (12,848), the United States (3,134), Peru (1,997) and Canada (1,119). PAHO plans to assess Mexico's measles elimination certification in November this year.

h5BWyHp6unSxLoPpskILog.zh: 歐洲去(2025)年5月截至今年8月累計報告341例確定病例,其中近半數疫情集中於今年5月以後,病患以4歲以下嬰幼兒為多,報告病例以英國(474例)及荷蘭(106例)為多,近期比利時因受雞蛋污染影響,報告逾300例病例。歐洲食品安全局(EFSA)統計全歐每年約報告9.1萬例,估計每年醫療與生產力損失等經濟負擔達30億歐元,當局呼籲⺠眾外食時,應避免食用未熟肉類、雞蛋與未加熱消毒之乳製品。
h5BWyHp6unSxLoPpskILog.en: From May 2025 to August this year, Europe cumulatively reported 341 confirmed cases, nearly half of which occurred after May this year; most patients were infants and children under 4. The United Kingdom (474 cases) and the Netherlands (106 cases) reported the most. Recently, Belgium has reported more than 300 cases due to contaminated eggs. EFSA estimates that about 91,000 cases are reported across Europe each year, with an estimated annual economic burden, including healthcare and productivity losses, of €3 billion. Authorities advise people eating out to avoid undercooked meat, raw eggs and unpasteurised dairy products.

ZVUSl-BJ_A5pmKiM1wBo-w.zh: 歐洲疫情更新,自去(2025)年5月迄今年8月累計報告341例確定病例,其中至少34例住院,疫情自5月起顯著上升(新增152例),病患分布於英國(207例)、荷蘭(106例)、比利時(15例)、德國(6 例)等7國,英國研判疑感染源為進口雞蛋,荷蘭懷疑感染源為雞肉。全基因定序顯示,本次菌株與2025年於荷蘭通報之雞蛋與家禽疫情相關。
ZVUSl-BJ_A5pmKiM1wBo-w.en: Europe update: from May 2025 to August this year, 341 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, of which at least 34 were hospitalised. The outbreak has risen markedly since May (152 new cases), with patients distributed across seven countries, including the UK (207 cases), the Netherlands (106), Belgium (15) and Germany (6). The UK suspects imported eggs as the source of infection, and the Netherlands suspects chicken meat. Whole-genome sequencing shows that this strain is related to egg and poultry outbreaks reported in the Netherlands in 2025.

KVndG6H0ESMvTZdnm_c-4A.zh: 英國、奧地利、比利時等共10個歐州國家今年截至5月累計報告109例病例,其中1例死亡、18例住院,病患以女性、成人為多,經調查感染源為苜蓿芽種子,由印度進口並分銷歐洲各地,各國已要求廠商將產品下架,ECDC評估此事件對於經常食用者的風險為低至中。
KVndG6H0ESMvTZdnm_c-4A.en: Ten European countries, including the United Kingdom, Austria and Belgium, reported 109 cases cumulatively this year through May, including 1 death and 18 hospitalizations. Patients are mainly female and adults. The source of infection was identified as alfalfa sprout seeds imported from India and distributed across Europe. Countries have required manufacturers to withdraw the products from sale. The ECDC assesses the risk of this event to frequent consumers as low to moderate.

6eIB_85kWZQUTi9tXP5T8A.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至5/30累計282例確診病例(42例死亡、2例康復),目前尚有321例待確認之疑病例。疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共22個衛生區。另烏干達目前9例確診病例 (1例死亡)。 巴西當局於聖保羅與里約熱內盧監測2名伊波拉疑個案:案1為近期自DRC入境之DRC籍男性,案2為近期自烏干達入境之比利時籍男性。兩案雖已分別確診腦膜炎與瘧疾,惟尚未排除伊波拉病毒共感染之可能性,目前均已隔離並等待檢驗結果。 WHO秘書長譚德塞於5/30親赴DRC伊圖里省重災區視察,強調妥善治療可提高存活率。
6eIB_85kWZQUTi9tXP5T8A.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 30 May, 282 confirmed cases (42 deaths, 2 recovered) had been reported, and 321 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. The outbreak is concentrated in 22 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda currently has nine confirmed cases (1 death). Brazilian authorities are monitoring two suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro: case 1 is a DRC national man who recently entered Brazil from the DRC, and case 2 is a Belgian man who recently entered from Uganda. Although they were diagnosed with meningitis and malaria respectively, Ebola virus co-infection has not been ruled out, and both are isolated awaiting test results. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the hard-hit area of Ituri Province, DRC, on 30 May and stressed that proper treatment can improve survival.

YxKtFQoc5zTGFdy-7gaxyg.zh: 比利時今年2/19-5/11累計報告236例確診病例,病患分布於各年齡層,經調查疑感染源為某生產商販售之雞蛋,當局已要求將商品下架。另該國2025年累計報告3,375例食物相關傳染病病例,其中有71例住院。
YxKtFQoc5zTGFdy-7gaxyg.en: From 19 February to 11 May this year, Belgium has reported 236 confirmed cases across all age groups. The investigation suspects eggs sold by a certain producer as the source, and authorities have asked for the products to be withdrawn. In 2025, Belgium reported 3,375 foodborne infectious disease cases cumulatively, of which 71 were hospitalised.

GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年2/28累計144國/地區報告18萬1千餘例確診病例,其中,至少492例死亡。 今年2月共計46國家/地區報告1,184 例新增確診病例,其中4例死亡,58.6%來自非洲地區,相較今年1月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降或持平,阿根廷、奧地利及中非共和國通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/2/1-3/15)共計17國通報907例確診病例,其中7例死亡,以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、肯亞、蒲隆地及賴比瑞亞為高;非洲以外地區,奧地利、比利時、葡萄牙、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。
GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.en: Monthly update: Since 2022 and up to 28 February this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 181,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 492 died. In February this year, 46 countries and regions reported 1,184 new confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; 58.6% came from the African Region. Compared with January this year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined or held steady. Argentina, Austria and the Central African Republic reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (1 February–15 March 2026), 17 countries reported 907 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths; the highest numbers were in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Burundi and Liberia. Outside Africa, Austria, Belgium, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to report clade Ib community transmission.

q-MJ3R-fOOCDxmf2Mbm1Kw.zh: ECDC報告歐洲2024年發生6,558起食物相關疫情事件,累計報告6萬2,481例病例,其中3,336例住院、53例死亡,整體疫情較2023年上升。所有食物相關之疫情中以沙門氏菌感染症為大宗共1,238起疫情,通報案件以法國、荷蘭、西班牙及比利時為多,其中有65起群聚事件之影響人數超過百人,另諾羅病毒則引起631起疫情;經調查交叉污染與未經適當處理、加熱處理不足及廚師受感染為疫情常見原因,發生地以學校、幼稚園、餐廳或職場最常見。
q-MJ3R-fOOCDxmf2Mbm1Kw.en: The ECDC reported that Europe recorded 6,558 food-related outbreak events in 2024, with 62,481 cases cumulatively, 3,336 hospitalisations and 53 deaths; the overall situation was higher than in 2023. Salmonella infection accounted for the largest share of food-related outbreaks, with 1,238 outbreaks. Most notifications came from France, the Netherlands, Spain and Belgium. Of these outbreaks, 65 clusters affected more than 100 people. Norovirus caused 631 outbreaks. Investigations found that common causes were cross-contamination, inadequate processing, insufficient heating and infected food handlers. Outbreaks most often occurred in schools, kindergartens, restaurants or workplaces.

TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.zh: 希臘11/1報告該國首例Ib型境外移入病例,該病患曾具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,並發生MSM行為。歐洲6國於10/11-20期間報告至少8例I型病例,分別為德國/義大利各2例、比利時/荷蘭/葡萄牙/西班牙各1例,其中2例不具旅遊史,其中3例為MSM族群,顯示可能在同性/雙性族群中尚有未發現的社交傳播鏈。當局評估MSM族群傳播風險為中,一般民眾為低。 英國自2022年截至今年10/31已累計3,732例病例,其中,累計18例Ib型病例,大多數病例與前往Ib型流行國家有直/間接關聯,該國於11/3新增報告1例Ib型病例,即具泰國旅遊史。由於近期歐、美洲MSM族群傳播風險升高,當局評估將該病輸入傳播風險從中提升至高。
TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.en: Greece reported on 1 November its first imported clade Ib case; the patient had a travel history to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and had engaged in MSM behaviour. Between 11 and 20 October, six European countries reported at least eight clade Ib cases: Germany and Italy 2 each, and Belgium, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain 1 each. Two of these cases had no travel history, and three were in the MSM population, suggesting that undetected social transmission chains may exist among men who have sex with men and bisexual populations. Authorities assess the transmission risk in the MSM population as moderate and for the general public as low. The United Kingdom has recorded 3,732 cases cumulatively since 2022 as of 31 October this year, including 18 clade Ib cases, most of which are directly or indirectly linked to travel to countries with clade Ib transmission. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 3 November, with a travel history to Thailand. Because the transmission risk among MSM in Europe and the Americas has recently increased, authorities have raised the assessed risk of importation and spread from moderate to high.

Iua_NyibxXZ9vvR-SvrZxA.zh: 法國自6月截至8/13累積報告18例病例,其中2例死亡,病患年齡介於34-95歲間,比利時、丹麥、荷蘭、挪威亦檢出相關案例;當局已下架疑感染源(牛/羊奶起司),惟該產品已銷往全球32個國家/地區,包含鄰近之香港、日本及韓國。
Iua_NyibxXZ9vvR-SvrZxA.en: France has reported 18 cases since June, as of 13 August, of which 2 died; patients are aged 34–95 years. Related cases have also been detected in Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway. Authorities have withdrawn the suspected source, a cheese made from cow's and sheep's milk, but the product has been sold to 32 countries and regions, including neighbouring Hong Kong, Japan and South Korea.

aXp7XeXQ9zLYEdt7JkYEJA.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共10國於2025/1/7-4/23期間新增41起H5N1疫情,匈牙利13起、波蘭9起、越南7起、美國5起、瑞典2起、南韓/比利時/法國/芬蘭/立陶宛各1起。 日本於2025/4/11-4/24期間新增3起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,031 (10)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第16週計410個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、明蘇達、紐澤西)4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:外媒報導2024年H1N2豬流感研究,病毒於歐洲由禽類跨物種傳播至豬隻形成H1N2 1C譜系,自2011-24年間報告至少29例人類感染事件,其中近半數發生於2021年後。據調查顯示多數人對該病毒無免疫力,目前疫苗對該病毒保護效力較低;於動物實驗中,病毒可與人類呼吸道受體結合,且可在支氣管細胞中有效複製,具高度穩定性及高活性神經胺酸酶等特性,評估具有人際傳播潛力。惟現有證據顯示病毒致死率低,於豬隻感染症狀亦屬輕微,且未具高致病性,惟因具備人際傳播潛力及多數人無免疫能力,仍需持續納入監測及定期風險評估。 年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,601起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
aXp7XeXQ9zLYEdt7JkYEJA.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 10 countries reported 41 new H5N1 outbreaks between 7 January and 23 April 2025: Hungary 13, Poland 9, Viet Nam 7, the United States 5, Sweden 2, and one each in South Korea, Belgium, France, Finland and Lithuania. Japan reported 3 new H3N8 outbreaks between 11 and 24 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,031 (10) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 16, 410 sampling sites provided test reports, and 4 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Minnesota and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: foreign media reported on a 2024 study of H1N2 swine influenza. The virus was transmitted from birds to pigs in Europe, forming the H1N2 1C lineage; at least 29 human infection events were reported between 2011 and 2024, nearly half of them after 2021. Investigations show that most people have no immunity to this virus, and current vaccines offer less protection against it. In animal experiments, the virus could bind to human respiratory receptors and replicate efficiently in bronchial cells, and it showed high stability and highly active neuraminidase; it is assessed to have potential for human-to-human transmission. However, current evidence shows that the virus has a low fatality rate, causes mild symptoms in pigs, and is not highly pathogenic. Nevertheless, given its potential for human-to-human transmission and the fact that most people lack immunity, it should remain under continued surveillance and regular risk assessment. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,601 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.zh: 歐洲3/6報告,自2023/1-2025/1期間,累計9個國家/區509例病,分別為挪威(257例)、瑞典(110)、芬蘭(94)、德國(30)、荷蘭(9)、丹麥(4)、法國(3)、比利時(1)、愛沙亞(1)。多國調查皆認為感染源為義大利某產地之苜蓿芽,基因定序亦有相同結論,當局已實施相關介入措施,以防止受汙染產品進入市場。
9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.en: Europe reported on 6 March that, between January 2023 and January 2025, 509 cases had been reported cumulatively in 9 countries: Norway 257, Sweden 110, Finland 94, Germany 30, the Netherlands 9, Denmark 4, France 3, Belgium 1 and Estonia 1. Investigations in several countries concluded that the source was alfalfa sprouts from a production site in Italy, and genetic sequencing reached the same conclusion. Authorities have implemented relevant interventions to prevent contaminated products from entering the market.

X9CEanq8aSpnVL9Om2mhQA.zh: 比利時12/18報告首例Ib型病例,病患已成年,發病前曾前往非洲疫區國家旅行,並與疑病例者有性接觸,返國後無高風險接觸者;ECDC評估進一步傳播風險仍低。目前已報告Ib疫情之非洲以外國家包括:加拿大/德國/印度/瑞典/泰國/英國/美國/比利時。
X9CEanq8aSpnVL9Om2mhQA.en: On 18 December, Belgium reported its first clade Ib case, an adult who had travelled to an African country with an outbreak before symptom onset and who had had sexual contact with a suspected case. There were no high-risk contacts after returning home. ECDC assesses the risk of further transmission as low. Countries outside Africa that have so far reported clade Ib outbreaks include Canada, Germany, India, Sweden, Thailand, the United Kingdom, the United States and Belgium.
